comments.body:
Thanks so much for the kind words! We’re really glad to hear the model is working well for you on real-world data.
I have uploaded the 12-layer model which is used by the current online Gradio demo. Please do  `bash ./scripts/download_weights_and_demo_data.sh` again to download this model. A new model with better handling of free 360 degree rotation will be updated soon.
